Best value ranks by average weekly price plus $15 for every yard of walk (so 100 yards ≈ $1,500). Area sorts north to south: Corolla, Duck, Southern Shores, Kitty Hawk, Kill Devil Hills, Nags Head, then Hatteras Island.

Walk is Google Maps' walking time and distance from the house to the nearest usable beach access (public or community walkway), checked on satellite so routes don't cut across private oceanfront lots. Oceanfront houses are measured straight out the back to the sand with Google's distance tool. Vrbo times are Vrbo's own estimates. Every house is within 0.3 mi of the beach. 🟢 Popular = only 1 or 2 of our 4 weeks were open when checked (book those first). ⚠️ marks anything I couldn't confirm.

Ratings: star scores and review counts come from each listing. Twiddy shows no star scores, only how many guests recommended the home (👍).

Pool heat: ✓ means the listing says the pool is heated or heat can be added (fees shown when listed). In July many pools aren't heated by default; confirm before booking.

🚩 Red flags come from guest reviews, map checks and the listings (checked Nov 19, 2026). Every house: confirm dog limits/weight rules, July pool-heat cost, and that 4 bedrooms have queen or king beds.

Vrbo: houses within ~5 min walk (Vrbo's estimate), rated 9.0/10+ (shown as 4.5★+) with 10+ reviews, under $9,000 including all Vrbo fees. Vrbo hides exact addresses, so there's no walking-route map; listings already on the page from an agency (Doodles & Dunes, Beach Dreams) and Carova 4x4 houses were left out.

Duplicates: all houses were cross-checked by map location and name across the four sites; none appear twice. (Two pairs sit next door to each other in Ocean Sands, e.g. 626 vs 627 Staysail Crescent, but they are different houses.)

Prices checked Nov 19, 2026 and include taxes (12.75% added where the site showed pre-tax). Pet fees, pool-heat fees and travel insurance are extra. Availability changes quickly.
